get.description:
email is the account's lower-cased email address; email_verified says whether it has been verified; two_factor
is true once two-factor authentication is confirmed; read_only is true for the read-only demo account. Signed
out, the answer is 401. The answer is never cached.

429.description: Too Many Requests: the rate limit of this route is spent.

get.description:
Everything PokéPrices keeps about the signed-in account, as a JSON download named pokeprices-export.json: the
account (email, when the email was verified, whether two-factor authentication is on, when the account was
created), the watchlist (with each alert threshold) and the portfolio ordered by variant key, the session records
newest first (last activity, IP address, browser), where alerts go, the webhooks (their url_hint only) and the
newest 500 deliveries (kind, channel, day, status, attempts, when). Times are RFC 3339 in UTC. It never holds
the password, a two-factor secret, a recovery code, a session id, session contents, a webhook URL, a signing
secret or a message body. The read-only demo account may download its data too; as every demo visitor shares
that account, its session records are only the caller's own, never another visitor's. The answer is never cached.

429.description: Too Many Requests: the rate limit of this route is spent.

post.description:
Deletes the signed-in account after checking its current password, sent in the JSON body (never in the URL):
the account, its watchlist, its portfolio, every session record and any password reset token, in one
transaction. This browser is signed out. A wrong password answers 422 with errors.password; password checks
are limited to 5 a minute per account (429). The demo account is read-only (403 demo-read-only).

get.description: The variants on the signed-in account's watchlist, ordered by card id, then variant key. Each carries its card's name, set name and number from the PokéSearch catalog (card is null when PokéSearch does not have the id; while PokéSearch is unavailable, names come from the last good copy or are null, and meta.degraded is true) and the card page's price block: the variant's newest daily close from TCGplayer market prices via TCGCSV with source, feed, day and as_of, the previous close and the change (price is null when the collected snapshots hold no close for it). meta.limit is the most variants a watchlist holds. The answer is never cached.

put.description: Puts the variant on the watchlist; the answer is the same 200 whether it was added now or was already there. A key that names no PokéPrices variant, or a full watchlist (meta.limit variants), answers 422 with errors.variant_key. The demo account is read-only (403 demo-read-only).
put.summary: Add a variant to your watchlist

get.description: The variants the signed-in account holds, ordered by card id, then variant key, each with its quantity, its card's name from the PokéSearch catalog (as on the watchlist; meta.degraded is true while PokéSearch is unavailable) and the card page's price block from TCGplayer market prices via TCGCSV. value is quantity × close, computed by PokéPrices as a decimal string; it is null when the collected snapshots hold no close for the variant, which is then never counted as zero. meta.total_value sums the priced holdings (null when none is priced), meta.priced and meta.unpriced count them, and meta.first_day and meta.last_day are the oldest and newest close days the total rests on. The answer is never cached.

put.description: Sets the quantity (1 to 9999) held of the variant, creating the holding when needed; the quantity is set, never added to, and the answer is the same 200 either way. A key that names no PokéPrices variant, a full portfolio (meta.limit variants) or a bad quantity answers 422. The demo account is read-only (403 demo-read-only).
put.summary: Set how many of a variant you hold

get.description: The signed-in account's webhooks, ordered by id: kind standard is a signed webhook (Standard Webhooks), kind discord a Discord webhook. url_hint is the URL's scheme and host only; the full URL and the signing secret are never shown again. disabled is true once the receiver said the webhook no longer exists (410, or Discord's 404 or 401). last_delivery is the newest message to it: its status and when (delivered, else created; RFC 3339 UTC), or null before the first. meta.limit is the most signed webhooks an account holds (plus one Discord webhook). The answer is never cached.

429.description: Too Many Requests: the rate limit of this route is spent.

post.description: Registers a signed webhook (kind standard) or a Discord webhook (kind discord) for the signed-in account. The URL must be https and reach a public address (PokéPrices does not send to private, local or reserved networks); a Discord URL looks like https://discord.com/api/webhooks/<id>/<token>. The 201 answer carries the signing secret of a signed webhook, once: it is never shown again (to change it, delete the webhook and add it again); for Discord secret is null. An account holds at most 5 signed webhooks and one Discord webhook. Refusals answer 422 with errors.kind, errors.url or errors.description. Only a verified account may add webhooks (403 email-not-verified); the demo account is read-only (403 demo-read-only).

403.description: The demo account is read-only (problem type https://pokeprices.andrestheperez.com/problems/demo-read-only), or the account's email address is not verified yet (problem type https://pokeprices.andrestheperez.com/problems/email-not-verified).

delete.description: Deletes the signed-in account's webhook with this id, and every message still waiting for it. Deleting the Discord webhook while alerts go to Discord sets them back to email. The answer is 204 also when the account has no webhook with this id (nothing changes). The demo account is read-only (403 demo-read-only).

post.description: Queues one test message to the signed-in account's webhook with this id and answers 202 with its message_id (the webhook-id header of a signed webhook); it is sent within a few minutes. A signed webhook receives a webhook.test message that carries no price; a Discord webhook a short text. 404 webhook-not-found when the account has no webhook with this id; 409 webhook-disabled when the webhook is turned off. At most 5 test messages a minute (429). Only a verified account may send test messages (403 email-not-verified); the demo account is read-only (403 demo-read-only).

put.description: Sets the alert threshold of one variant on the signed-in account's watchlist: a whole percentage from the movement rule's 5 (and at least $1.00) to 100. When that card's daily close moves by at least the threshold against the previous close, an alert is sent where alerts go (GET /v1/me/notifications). A key that names no PokéPrices variant or a variant not on the watchlist answers 422 with errors.variant_key; a pct that is not such a whole number answers 422 with errors.pct. Only a verified account may set alerts (403 email-not-verified); the demo account is read-only (403 demo-read-only).
put.summary: Set an alert on a watchlist card

get.description: Where the signed-in account's alerts and daily digest are sent: channel email (the account's email address) or discord (its Discord webhook); digest says whether a daily digest is sent, once per collected day, listing the watched cards that moved; discord_available says whether the account has a Discord webhook that is not turned off. Without a saved choice the answer is email with no digest. The answer is never cached.

put.description: Saves where the signed-in account's alerts and daily digest are sent (channel email or discord) and whether a daily digest is sent (digest true or false); the answer is the same body as GET. Choosing discord needs a Discord webhook that is not turned off (422 errors.channel otherwise). Only a verified account may choose (403 email-not-verified); the demo account is read-only (403 demo-read-only).

post.description:
Signs this browser session in as the shared demo account, which holds a seeded watchlist and portfolio and can
read them but change nothing (every write answers 403 demo-read-only). The session is regenerated. Send it as
a first-party request with the X-XSRF-TOKEN header from GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie. When the demo is switched off
or has not been seeded, the answer is 404 demo-unavailable.
post.summary: Sign in to the read-only demo account

get.description: Proxies PokéSearch's search with q (the search text), page (from 1; PokéSearch clamps it to its last reachable page) and page_size (PokéSearch's default is 24) only; any other query parameter answers 422. Pagination passes through unchanged: pages is PokéSearch's count, which stops at its 9,600-result window, so read pages rather than computing it from total.
get.summary: Search cards in the PokéSearch catalog

get.description: The card comes from the PokéSearch catalog; variants lists the PokéPrices variants of the card with their current TCGplayer mappings, and catalog names the PokéSearch dataset that answered. Each variant carries price: its newest daily close from TCGplayer market prices via TCGCSV, one close per day, with source, feed and as_of on each variant (as_of is the snapshot marker of the close's day), the previous close of the same series epoch within 14 days and the change since it; price is null when the collected snapshots hold no close for the variant. An id outside the PokéSearch card id pattern, or one PokéSearch does not have, answers 404 card-not-found; catalog_missing is true when PokéPrices holds variant rows for an id PokéSearch no longer has (the rows are flagged, never deleted). While PokéSearch is unavailable the last good copy answers with meta.degraded true and meta.stale_since, or 503 when there is none.
get.summary: Read one card, hydrated with its PokéPrices variants

get.description: as_of is the snapshot marker of the newest successfully ingested TCGCSV day (TCGplayer market prices, one close per day) and day is its date; age_hours is the time from as_of to measured_at in hours with one decimal, rounded half up. within_slo is judged on the unrounded age: true while it is under slo_hours (26), so 25.96 hours is within the SLO even though it shows 26.0. measured_at is the server clock and the only clock value in the answer. With no successful ingest, as_of, day and age_hours are null and within_slo is false. last_run is the newest ingest run of any status (null when none ran). A breached SLO is a normal 200 answer: it means no newer day was ingested in time. The answer is never cached.
get.summary: How old the newest collected PokéPrices prices are, against the 26 hour freshness SLO

429.description: Too Many Requests: the rate limit of this route is spent.

get.description: One series per PokéPrices variant of the card, ordered by variant_key, each with its daily points ascending by day: TCGplayer market prices via TCGCSV, one close per day. range is 1W, 1M, 3M, YTD or 1Y (default 1M); the window ends on to, the newest ingested day, and starts on from (to minus 6, 29, 89 or 364 days, or January 1 of to's year for YTD), so it follows the data, never the clock. Days without a row are gaps. A filled point (is_filled true) repeats the close of filled_from for at most 14 days; every point's as_of is the snapshot marker of the close it shows, and meta.as_of is the marker of the newest ingested day. series_epoch changes when the variant's TCGplayer mapping starts a new series; never compare closes across it. history_begins is the day of the variant's first collected close in any series epoch, or null when PokéPrices holds none; it does not depend on range. With nothing ingested yet, from, to and as_of are null and every series is empty. The prices come from PokéPrices alone: a valid id PokéPrices holds no variants for answers 200 with data: [], which does not mean the card is unknown (GET /v1/cards/{id} says whether a card exists). An id outside the card id pattern answers 404 card-not-found.
get.summary: Read the daily closes of a card's variants over a chart range

get.description: The variants whose TCGplayer market close (via TCGCSV, one close per day) moved most against their previous close, from the ranked snapshot PokéPrices builds when it ingests a day: meta.day is the newest day with movers and meta.as_of its snapshot marker. A variant counts when it has a real close on that day and a previous close of at least meta.min_previous_close (2.00 USD) in the same series epoch within 14 days; direction up lists rises and down lists falls (default up), ranked by the absolute change in percent, then the absolute change, then variant_key; limit is 1 to 50 (default 20). The window is the previous close, which may be more than one day back when a day had no close. Each row names its card from the PokéSearch catalog (card is null when PokéSearch does not have the id); while PokéSearch is unavailable, names come from the last good copy or are null, and meta.degraded is true. With no movers yet, data is [] and meta.day and meta.as_of are null.
get.summary: Read the biggest movers of the newest collected day
